plan.objective: Retry webhook delivery up to three times when the transport reports a failure
expectedSchemas: deliver return value: { url: string, delivered: boolean, attempts: number }
plan.intent: Add bounded retry behavior to webhook delivery: src/notify/webhook.js currently calls the injected transport exactly once and reports delivered from response.ok; change deliver() to re-invoke the transport after a reported failure (response.ok !== true or a thrown transport error) for a maximum of three total attempts, returning on the first success and reporting delivered:false with the attempt count after the third failure. This adds retry behavior only — no existing keys (url, delivered) are removed or renamed, the transport signature (url, event) is unchanged, and no sleeps, timers, or backoff delays are introduced so tests stay synchronous. Assumption to confirm at implementation: "up to three times" is read as three total attempts (one initial call plus two retries); if the intent is three retries after the initial call, only the MAX_ATTEMPTS constant changes. Scope is confined to the notify/webhook module and its own test file per the README rule that a change to one module must not touch another module's tests; src/notify/email.js, pricing, audit, export, and search are untouched. No new dependencies, config keys, services, or network access — the transport is caller-injected and tests use fakes.

plan.objective: Orders paid by card should cost an extra five percent on top of what the customer would otherwise pay
expectedSchemas: order.payment (new optional field on the order object read by pricing; card indicated by payment.method === "card" or payment === "card")
plan.intent: Add a new card-payment surcharge: a 5% uplift applied to the fully-computed order total (lines, discount, delivery and tax) when the order is paid by card, leaving non-card and payment-less orders unchanged.

plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
plan.intent: Add a conditional free-delivery waiver in src/pricing/total.js: introduce a FREE_DELIVERY_FROM = 100 threshold and gate the existing flat DELIVERY = 3 charge so it is zero when the post-discount, pre-tax line subtotal is >= 100 and 3 otherwise. This adds threshold-gated exemption behavior; it does not remove the fee, change its amount for sub-threshold orders, or alter discount, tax, or rounding. Tests are added to the existing test/total.test.js only (below-threshold, exactly-100 boundary, above-threshold, and discount-pushes-below-threshold cases), keeping the repository's one-test-file-per-module rule from README.md.

plan.objective: Add a flat two pound handling charge to every order's total
plan.intent: Add behavior: introduce a new flat GBP 2 handling charge constant in src/pricing/total.js and include it in every orderTotal computation alongside the existing DELIVERY constant (added before tax so it is taxed like delivery), plus a covering test in test/total.test.js. No existing charge is removed, and no configuration, API, schema, or other module is changed.
